props.name: items
props.description: Items shown in the row, one per slide.

props.name: itemWidth
props.description: Width of each item in px.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Height of each item in px.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Horizontal distance between side items in px.

props.name: initial
props.description: Index shown first. Defaults to the middle.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
